description: Land Acquisition - Yalwela, Rideemaliyadda D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act for a specific project (Morana Tank Project). It provides detailed descriptions of the land parcels being acquired, including lot numbers, names, claimants, and extents. It also outlines the legal process for interested parties to claim compensation. This fits squarely within Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals specifically with land acquisition and property matters.
